title: Can I accompany my child during their Speech Therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network?
metaTitle: Parent's Involvement in Speech Therapy Sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn about the importance of parents' involvement during their child's speech therapy sessions at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Understand how your presence can support your child's progress at the center.
html: Parents' involvement is encouraged at Pinnacle Blooms Network. Your presence during sessions depends on the child's comfort and the therapist’s discretion.
